facts.fact: The African American Family Monument stands on River Street and depicts an emancipated family.
facts.excerpt: depicting a newly emancipated family of four standing together in an embrace.

facts.fact: Its broken chains symbolise emancipation rather than a purely decorative waterfront story.
facts.excerpt: their modern clothing and the broken chains at their feet symbolize a new beginning in the Americas.

facts.fact: Official heritage interpretation explicitly documents enslaved people who built and maintained historic households.
facts.excerpt: the enslaved men, women, and children who built the mansion and maintained the household.
